name: list_jeb_units
description: List project units by stable unit path and type, with optional wildcard filter, parent restriction, and pagination. The engine caps pages at 100 units; a full page reports partial coverage because more units may exist. Read-only.

count.description: Maximum results to return; the engine protocol caps pages at 100

filter.description: Wildcard filter matched against unit paths; '*' allowed

index.description: Zero-based index of the first result to return

parent_unit_path.description: Restrict results to descendants of this unit path
